name: Abyss: Vault
description:
The elites left you for dead on Earth's surface. Their mistake. Now your rebel squad must infiltrate their underwater vault, steal what they hoarded, and hijack their rocket. But the vault has a mind of its own. And it doesn't want visitors.

Wield your light weapons: red, blue, green and combine your beams to crack each code, battle hostile enemies, and escape with Earth's last hope for a new life. In Abyss: Vault, lone players fail. Coordinated squads survive.

name: Aim Assault
description: A retro-inspired co-op arcade shooter packed with nonstop action. Team up to face relentless waves of enemies and dodge incoming bullets as you race against time. Confront the villainous Jaguar in a dramatic boss fight finale. Perfect for 1-6 players looking for intense action.

name: Alice in Wonderland
description:
Alice needs your help! The wonderful, crazy world she has been sucked into is holding her captive. Be careful that the same fate doesn’t befall you…

Solve puzzles and race against time with friends and family to discover what is happening in the Wonderland. Unveil the mysteries and bring her back!

name: Arctic Olympics
description:
Prepare for an epic VR experience with Arctic Olympics - a captivating competition set in the icy Arctic! Enter the Slingshot Challenge, where you'll stand on an ice floe and aim your snowball launcher at moving targets all around you. Enjoy the freedom of movement in this free-roaming VR game, enhanced by exciting power-ups that ramp up your points.

Dive into a fierce competition with your friends and family. Whether you're defending your high score or aiming for the top spot, Arctic Olympics offers a thrilling and inclusive VR experience for all ages and skill levels. Jump into the action and see if you have what it takes to claim the Ice Trophy!

Ideal for groups of 2-8 players aged 7 and up, Arctic Olympics is a fast-paced shooter for both casual gamers and dedicated competitors.

name: Arrowsong
description: Goblins, machines and a menacing dragon are out to destroy the sacred tree! You and your band of heroes have been called upon to stop this evil and bring peace to the fairy realm. A dangerous mission that might overwhelm even the most seasoned adventurer.

name: Arrowsong: Dark Omen
description: Fight side by side in a new thrilling VR adventure against the forces of the Dark Lord. Master your bow, survive intense battles, and carve a path through dark, cursed lands. As an ancient evil rises, a fanatical cult races to complete a ritual that will doom the world. Stand together, stop the cult, and become the last hope against the coming darkness.

name: Atlantis
description:
Atlantis - the legendary Lost City - is said to have an endless power source. This power was deemed too dangerous, and it was hidden in the city, protected by trials so only the worthy would ever reach it.

You are on a mission to find said endless power and you will need to solve puzzles and overcome many obstacles to reach it.

Dive into Atlantis with up to 7 other players and show that you are worthy!

name: B-Block Breakout
description:
Play the role of a group of scallywags locked away in the infamous B Block in this thrilling escape room. Solve puzzles together as you work your way through the prison's interiors to freedom.

Two to six players can participate in this thrilling interactive adventure. With three difficulties, but the same quality of experience, players of all experience levels will enjoy executing The B Block Breakout.

name: Beyond Medusa's Gate
description:
Beyond Medusa's Gate is set in the re-creation of Ancient Greece from Assassin's Creed® Odyssey.

Two or four players team up and have 60 minutes to find a way out of a vast Aegean coastal cave where the legendary ship of the Argonauts is anchored. To successfully escape, players must use cooperative teamwork, problem-solving skills and precise timing to solve riddles and find their way out of this room-scale experience. Players start the adventure by choosing their avatar from among six diverse characters, and can customize them with Ancient Greek accessories.

name: Carnival Showdown
description:
Step right up and enter the colourful world of Carnival Showdown, a fast-paced collection of competitive VR mini-games where every round brings a new challenge. Pop balloons, test your balance, sharpen your aim, and compete across a series of carnival-inspired games that are easy to learn, but difficult to master. With points on the line and only one winner, every challenge is a chance to climb the leaderboard.

Designed for players of all ages and experience levels, Carnival Showdown is the perfect introduction to freeroam VR. Its short, energetic rounds make it ideal for families, birthday parties, team-building events, or anyone looking for light-hearted competition packed with laughs, friendly rivalry, and plenty of replayability.

name: Castle Crusade
description: Castle Crusade is a medieval action game where you and your friends conquer castles and carve your way through enemy knights. You have a slingshot and your own knights at your disposal, using them to seize enemy territories. Be the first to destroy and occupy the enemy castles and maybe cause a little trouble for your fellow players along the way.

name: Chronosphere
description:
You and your party of brave adventurers have made your way to the evil wizard Yendor's magical tower in the hopes of recovering the Chronosphere, and returning life and time to its normal flow.

Navigate the maze, escape the well of souls, and solve the secrets of the observatory. Unique and amazing puzzles involve drinking magic potions, wielding powerful wands, warping time itself. One of the most incredible looking and cinematic experiences you will find in a VR escape room.

name: Cook'd Up
description: A family-friendly team-building game. Enter a virtual kitchen where you and your fellow chefs face the challenge of tons of hungry customers. Assign tasks, work together, and flip as many burgers as you physically can. As you and your chefs progress, the recipes will get more complicated, and intensive teamwork is required to keep the customers satisfied.

name: Cops vs Robbers
description:
Dive into the action-packed world of Cops vs Robbers, a fast-paced VR shooter where strategy, reflexes, and teamwork decide the outcome. With two thrilling game modes to choose from, you'll experience heart-pounding battles whether you're playing as Cop or Robber.

Heist Mode: Rustbeard and his ragtag gang are coming for the vault! In this mode, you and your team must defend the vault from the relentless assault of bandits. But when they make away with the loot, you'll have to strap in for an epic flying car chase as you pursue Rustbeard through the skies. With an arsenal of weapons at your disposal, you'll need every tool to fend off the heist and bring Rustbeard to justice.

PvP Mode: The vault has already been breached, and the robbery is in progress! Join the fray as either a Cop or Robber and engage in an all-out firefight inside the bank.

Two modes, one mission: claim victory!

name: Corsair's Curse
description: Jump aboard a mysterious galleon, looking for the Corsair's treasure. Alas! The Corsair appears and brings his curse upon you: you now look like tiny wooden idols. And if you are not able to solve the many puzzles and challenges that await you in the galleon, you and your friends shall become part of the Corsair's idols collection for all eternity!

name: Cyber Shock
description: A fast-paced futuristic shooter where players become digital warriors battling a dangerous virus inside their system. Dodge, shoot, and outsmart enemies in neon-charged virtual combat.

name: Cyberclash
description:
Grab your blasters, shoot your opponents and climb the ranks in this competitive shooter.

Explore massive environements covering different themes. Discover a space station, an ancient temple or a pirate bay.

Use the environment to your advantage, find power-ups and new weapons. Compete against other players in multiple games and become the Champion of the Arena.

name: Cyberclash Tournament
description: Explore the maps and always have an eye on your back if you want to stay at the top of the leaderboard.

name: Dark Z
description:
No longer afraid of the dark? Really? If you are so sure, enter the heart of the crypt of DARK Z and survive the hordes of monsters hiding in darkness!

This fight to the death will bring adrenaline kicks and new sensations!

Progressing in total darkness will be a hard challenge. Your aiming skills will no longer be sufficient: a cooperative team and a little (a lot?) of luck will be necessary for you to come out of this journey alive…

name: Dead Ahead
description: The apocalypse is here! You and your friends make a last stand to defend against the undead. You get 30 seconds to prepare your defences & pick your weapons before the zombies attack. Each wave the zombies become faster and the pressure builds up. Do you have what it takes to survive the apocalypse?

name: Dead Corps
description:
Build your loadout, grab some grenades and fend off hordes of the undead in Dead Corps - a new twist on the freeroam horde shooter genre.

Suitable for groups of 2-12 players from ages 12 and up, Dead Corps is packed to the brim with content. Choose from an arsenal of weapons, upgrade your character with powerful perks, and battle through 4 campaigns spanning 16 different maps to show the undead who's in charge around here!

Or just throw cans of beans at them, we're not fussed...

name: Death Squad
description:
DEATH SQUAD is a zombie wave shooter like you’ve never experienced before. Survive with your friends, upgrade your weapons, and explore new environments!

Are you ready to face a zombie apocalypse head on? The General Speakman needs you ASAP! Answer his call and protect the designated area until the arrival of the extraction team.

Earn money by killing zombies. Use it to unlock brand-new areas with better weapons and supplies. You’re feeling lucky? Roll the dice at the magic box and maybe you’ll receive the best weapon available!

This is it! You’ve been tasked to protect an area but nobody is coming to save you. Stay alive and survive as long as you can!

In Survival, make sure your whole squad doesn’t die or it’s GAME OVER! Unlock new areas and buy better gear if you want to have a chance against the unrelenting hordes of zombies…

Strange… the place seems too quiet, maybe… OH NO a hazmat! Everyone steps back and aims for the head, let’s try to survive!

Sandbox mode lets you take advantage of all open weapons and doors right from the start of the game. For less-experienced players or those looking for a less intense experience

name: Don't Scream
description:
Your sadistic host opens the gates to a world where your worst fears come to life. No jokes. No mercy. Just you, your nerves, and everything you never wanted to face.

In this nerve-racking VR experience, it's all about control. Your voice. Your breath. Your panic, every scream counts. Stay silent. Stay sharp. And above all: stay calm. Because whoever screams… loses.

name: DragonFall
description:
Step into the world of DragonFall, a thrilling VR archery game where you must face off against hordes of goblins and mythical creatures in a race to defend your realm. Waves of enemies surge towards your fortress, but with each victory, you’ll unlock powerful upgrades to your magical bow.

Face the dragon king in DragonFall!

Immerse yourself in the epic narrative of DragonFall with Story Mode. Journey through a captivating tale where your realm is under siege by goblins and mythical beasts. As you advance through the session, uncover the lore of your world and face increasingly formidable enemies. Each victory unveils powerful upgrades for your weapons. Story Mode offers a deep, immersive experience where every battle brings you closer to saving your kingdom from destruction.

Test your endurance and strategic prowess in Wave Survival Mode of DragonFall. Here, you face endless waves of goblins and mythical creatures determined to breach your fortress. With each wave more intense than the last, you’ll need to adapt your strategies and continuously upgrade your defenses to keep the invaders at bay. Survive as long as you can, achieving high scores and unlocking new abilities along the way. Perfect for players seeking an adrenaline-pumping challenge, Wave Survival Mode delivers relentless action and requires tactical skill to prevail against the ever-growing threat.

name: Escape the Lost Pyramid
description:
Escape The Lost Pyramid is an escape game in Virtual Reality, taking place in the world of Assassin's Creed Origins.

February 1928.

An expedition led by Sir Beldon Frye disappears somewhere in the Sinai Peninsula. A team of four and a dozen local porters were looking for the Lost Pyramid of Nebka… Or more precisely, "something" that should have been there. They were never seen again. Using the simulation reconstructed from their DNA memory, your team will put themselves in the shoes of the explorers. Find out what happened to the expedition. And more importantly, locate what they were looking for.

In the game, 2 or 4 players team up and have 60 minutes to find a way out of the pyramid of Nebka. Players will live a larger-than-life adventure. An adventure that would be far too dangerous or just impossible to live in real life.

name: Espionage Express
description: Agents, are you ready for your next mission? Your objective is to escape from a hacked train in pursuit of Dr. Montgomery.Solve puzzles left behind by the doctor, pay attention to yoursurroundings, and work together to succeed in this thrilling game of cat-and-mouse.

name: Galactic Arena
description: An explosive action shooter about humans versus orcs on intergalactic arenas. Every player is wrapped in powerful armor that protects them and flies off upon impact. Replenish your own armor by defeating an opponent.

name: Greenium
description: You are a scientist teleported to a distant planet to make it habitable. But the planet’s life-giving crystals are targeted by dangerous poachers. Solve ancient riddles, fight off enemies, and upgrade your spaceship in a race against time to secure the crystals and save the planet. Can you outsmart the poachers and complete your mission? The fate of this world is in your hands!

name: HunterVR
description:
Step into the wild with HunterVR, a high-energy multiplayer VR game that puts your hunting skills to the test. Grab a bow, a rifle or dual pistols and compete across forests, open plains and snowy mountains. Track wildlife, steady your aim and climb the leaderboard with accurate shots, long-distance hits and headshots.

Test your hunting skills in Realistic mode or jump into Arcade mode for a quicker round. Between hunts, blast tumbleweeds, smash snowmen and sharpen your aim in bonus target rounds.

For the fastest arcade action, jump into Rookie Rangers. Take on waves of bandits, UFOs and shooting targets in a high-score frenzy with no animal targets. Whether you're picking up a bow for the first time or coming back to beat your best score, every round gives you another shot at the top spot.

Step in. Gear up. Take your shot.

name: Insanity: The Haunting
description:
Dr. Nikolov, lost his wife in a terrible accident. His only daughter, Maureen, witnessed the tragedy and was never the same again. Nikolov turned away from medicine and toward something far darker. One fateful night, he performed a ritual to summon a powerful entity, hoping it would save Maureen. But something went wrong…

The asylum was consumed in blood and darkness, and no one was ever heard from again.

name: Kitchen Panic
description:
In this family-friendly freeroam cooking game, you’ll be transported to different Parisian restaurants under the mantle of Chef François.

You’ll start slow with simple orders and a few ingredients. As you work your way up the ladder, you’ll get promoted to new kitchens with increasing difficulty, additional ingredients, and unexpected hazards.

Do you have what it takes to become a true chef? Find out in Kitchen Panic!

In this family-friendly cooperative experience, you’ll be transported to different Parisian restaurants under the mantle of Chef François.

Prepare and serve dishes in time to satisfy your customers. Unlock new kitchen with new hazards and become a true chef!

Choose your favorite kitchen from the story mode and hone your craft!

Do you have what it takes to become a true chef? Forge your own path and find out!

In this game mode, the kitchen difficulty level is selected by the players.

Are you up for a challenge? Choose your kitchen and survive as long as you can!

If you don’t serve a customer in time, you get a strike. And, after three strikes, you’re out! How long can you last?

Show off your cooking skills! Choose your favorite kitchen and achieve the highest score.

Follow the recipes, prepare the dishes and serve them in time.

name: Kraken Island
description:
Embark on an epic journey in Kraken Island, a cooperative, freeroam family shooter!

Join forces to defend extraction robots and unearth pirate treasures amidst relentless skeleton assaults. Are you ready to team up and conquer the challenges of the island? Grab your crew and embark on the adventure today!

Be prepared to face waves of skeletons desperate to take possession of you. Defend your skin and beat all the scores!

This game mode offers an arcade-style shooting experience. Designed for shorter play sessions, the game adapts its difficulty throughout the game, right up to the climax, for a gripping experience!

Have you found the Captain’s treasure? His damned crew will do anything to get it back. Don’t turn your attention away from the chest!

This game mode lets players defend their treasure from the waves of skeletons that want to take it away. Designed for short play sessions, the difficulty increases throughout the game, right up to the climax! You’ll need to stay close to the chest to collect as much gold as possible.

The waves of enemies just won’t stop? Even better,you’ll get more points!

This game mode offers a longer experience, with a difficulty level that increases only slightly. Prefer it for longer sessions.

It looks like this treasure is huge – we’ve hit the jackpot! But the squelches are really mad!

This game mode is the equivalent of Treasure Hunt, but for longer sessions, with a constant level of difficulty.

name: Kraken Island: Captain's Curse
description:
Welcome to Kraken Island: Captain Curse. Discover or rediscover your childlike soul in this VR pirate adventure and set off to conquer the treasures of the past.

Make your way through the island’s passages and into the captain’s territory, paying close attention to the hordes of skeletons and their cannons pointed at you. And if you survive all the dangers along the way, don’t forget that the captain’s pet is notoriously grumpy.

name: Lunarscape
description:
Discover a VR freeroam escape room in complete immersion! Observe the Earth from the Moon and unlock the mysteries of LUNARSCAPE: BREAKDOWN!

Lunarscape : Breakdown – 30min

We haven’t heard any news from Lunar Base 42 for 72 hours. You and your team are sent to the moon to investigate. Explore the spatio-greenhouses, make new friends and solve the puzzle that impede your progress.

Communication with your teammates and deduction skills will be your biggest allies to carry out this mission successfully…Will you be able to finish your epic quest in space in time?

name: Mansion of Death
description:
Mansion of Death is a multiplayer virtual reality scary game that takes players deep into a mysterious haunted mansion. Designed as a 45-minute escape room experience, it challenges groups to work together to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and survive the terrors within.

Every corner of the mansion holds a new mystery. Players must communicate, explore, and think fast to escape before time runs out. With its immersive setting and suspenseful atmosphere, Mansion of Death offers a unique blend of fear and brain-teasing challenges.

name: Mask of the Pharaoh
description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Mask of the Pharaoh, a free-roam VR journey deep into an ancient Egyptian pyramid. When a renowned professor becomes trapped by a mysterious curse, it's up to your team to navigate hidden chambers, uncover long-forgotten secrets, and find a way to break the curse before it's too late.

Combining exploration, puzzle-solving, and teamwork, Mask of the Pharaoh is perfect for families, friends, and first-time VR players alike. Work together to overcome ancient challenges, discover the pyramid's hidden history, and experience a thrilling adventure where curiosity and cooperation are the keys to success.

name: Mission Planet X
description:
Commander Dawson handpicked your team. Not for what you know but for what you dare to do.

You're headed to Planet X: a barren, hostile world full of secrets, dangers… and perhaps something that doesn't belong. Ancient theories speak of a source of unimaginable power: the Energy Crystal.

Our only hope to save Earth. But nothing is what it seems. Leave the ship. Work as one. Stay sharp.

The future of humankind is in your hands if you make it back.

name: Mission Z
description:
Enter with your team in this zombie-infested manor and try to survive MISSION Z… Lord Grave won’t take your presence in his home too kindly and will quickly release his creatures on your team.

You will have to take refuge and run away, sometimes taking elevators to unknown destinations…

A combination of great aiming, cooperation, and deductive skills will be needed to overcome these inconvenient hosts… Can you count on your friends? Discover it in this VR zombie shooter

name: Mission Z II
description:
Lord Grave is not done yet and VEX Corp needs your help to shut him down once again. New intel seems to point to a hidden mine deep underneath his manor.

Explore new environments, solve puzzles and escort a bomb deeper into the mine. As you suspect it, Lord Grave’s creations won’t appreciate your visit and you’ll have to survive against hordes of them.

Embark on a crazy train ride and survive Lord Grave’s biggest challenge yet in Mission Z II, our best Zombie Freeroaming game

Get ready for the ride of your life!

name: Monkey Madness
description: Monkey Madness: Jungle Games is a party game where you and your friends compete to earn the favor of the Great Monkey Emperor! Face off in up to 25 exciting jungle challenges that test your skill, rhythm, reflexes, and even your luck.Pop balloons, dodge walls, climb vines, smash nails, jam along in the bongo rhythm game, or hurl fruit with perfect aim. Every game brings new chaos and laughter. Choose your favorite games or let the jungle decide your fate.Fast, funny, and fiercely competitive, Monkey Madness: Jungle Games is the ultimate VR showdown where only one can become the emperor’s champion!

name: NanoClash
description:
NanoClash is a large-scale competitive free-roam VR experience that links two arenas together into a single game, effectively doubling player capacity and creating an epic arena-versus-arena battle. Each arena becomes its own team, with players working together to capture powerups, and overcome their opponents, resulting in is a fast-paced experience that combines teamwork, communication, and friendly competition in a way that simply isn't possible in a single arena.

With capacity for larger groups without the need for one giant arena, NanoClash is a fantastic choice for birthday parties, corporate events, school trips, and team-building activities. Friends, colleagues, and family members can split into opposing teams and compete for victory, creating memorable moments, plenty of laughs, and the perfect excuse for a rematch once the battle is over.

Don't have two arenas? Check out NanoClash's single-arena sibling RoboClash for a Player vs. AI take on the experience.

name: Party Playland
description:
In this family-friendly party game experience, you are transported to a colorful world where you and your friends will compete to become the latest and greatest Party Champion. Discover a freeroam VR playground like never before!

Each mini-game offers a unique challenge and adventure. Whether you’re casting your fishing rod to snag chickens, squashing invading crabs, avoiding traps, and more. Every round promises thrills and laughter. Party Playland guarantees an unforgettable party experience filled with endless fun and excitement!

Take part in colorful mini-games from the world of party playland! This party game is perfect for children’s groups, birthday parties and people who want to compete in a fun way.

In arcade mode, players compete in a mini-game of their choice, selected in advance. Perfect for those who want to practice a specific mini-game!

The fiesta mode offers a randomized gaming experience, with players not knowing the challenges they’ll face in advance, but discovering them as they go along!

This game mode allows players to choose their mini-game directly in the session, with a dedicated selection lobby. Rather practical for long sessions where players can choose their own course.

name: Party Ship
description: Set sail on a chaotic Caribbean adventure in this fun co-op game made for friends. Battle sharks, outwit ruthless pirates, and survive the high seas together. Perfect for 2-6 players looking for teamwork and laughter.

name: Pixel Hack
description: A multiplayer cooperative shooting game that combines elements of shooting, cooperation, bullet hell, dodging, and music. Set in a world that blends reality with fiction, the game uses pixelated art style to give players a nostalgic feeling of playing arcade games from their childhood.

name: Plush Rush
description:
You are a group of plush toys guarding a jar of candy against an ever growing toy army. If they manage to get the last piece of candy, it's game over! Protect it with all the tools you have available...

Plush Rush is set in a toy world in a child's bedroom. The game is suited perfectly for your younger audience or kids birthdays, while letting adults relive their nostalgic childhood memories.

name: Portal Arcade
description: A vibrant, arcade-style PvP shooter for free-roam VR arenas, crafted for fans of colorful worlds and iconic characters. Play across 6 maps.

name: Portal Mafia
description: A team-based tactical PvP first-person shooter in the style of America in the 50s. Confront the police and mafiosi on 2 exciting maps: "City" and "Casino".

name: Portal Strike
description: A team-based tactical PvP first-person shooter in VR, played across 6 maps.

name: Portal Zombie
description: A cooperative first-person horror game set in an old, abandoned mansion under attack by hordes of zombies. Team up with friends, survive multiple waves of zombie attacks, and take on a powerful boss for the ultimate challenge!

name: Precise Force
description:
Precise Force is a standalone free-roam VR action shooting cinematic experience designed for immersive multiplayer gameplay. Players are deployed into intense combat missions where teamwork, fast reactions, and tactical movement are essential to survive.

Players will fight through enemy forces, complete mission objectives, explore dynamic environments, and face epic boss battles in a highly immersive sci-fi military adventure.

Precise Force combines the freedom of movement with cinematic storytelling to create a next-generation VR combat experience.

name: Quantum Arena
description: Challenge your friends in an intense futuristic tournament! Team-up or fight in a free-for-all battle for the highest score. Beware as players are not the only danger to look out for!

name: RE:COIL
description:
Get ready to face off against your friends and family in RE:COIL - the ultimate competitive VR shooter.

Suitable for groups of 2-20 players from ages 7 and up, RE:COIL is built for everyone from casual players to hardcore esport fans. Battle across a diverse set of arenas in this energetic shooter, landing skillful bounce shots and deflecting incoming projectiles with your energy shield.

name: Riddle of Ruins
description: Welcome, adventurers, to "Riddle of Ruins: VR Adventure"! Step into the shoes of daring contestants who venture into an ancient temple every week to test their wits and luck. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and hunt for lost treasures in a fully immersive virtual reality experience. Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the ultimate temple explorer? Join us and find out!

name: RoboClash
description:
RoboClash is the single-arena sibling to NanoClash, delivering the same fast-paced combat experience in a format designed for a single arena. Players work together to battle waves of AI enemy combatants, dodge incoming attacks, and collect powerups as they fight for their lives. Easy to learn but challenging to master, RoboClash combines teamwork, movement and arcade-style action into an accessible experience that's perfect for both first-time VR players and seasoned competitors.

Unlike NanoClash's multi-arena, arena-versus-arena format, RoboClash keeps the entire group together in a single shared battlefield, making it an excellent choice for venues running one arena while still delivering the same energetic sci-fi action.

name: Rotten Apple
description:
Since the outbreak, New York has been turned into an isolated quarantine zone. You and your squad are just on the way to the quarantine zone border to reinforce the guard when an unexpected emergency call forces you to enter. Those who enter the quarantine zone rarely return. Can you and your team survive?

Rotten Apple: New York Fallen is a narrative horror experience for 2 - 4 players. Set in a post-apocalyptic New York, players can choose from an engaging 30-40 minute story mode, or see how long they can last in the endless waveshooter mode against escalating waves of the undead.

name: Rush Z
description:
If you’ve ever dreamed of being part of a zombie apocalypse to shoot tons of them, this survival mode is made for you! Resist as much as you can in RUSH Z because these hordes of creatures won’t spare you!

Bring your guns and hold on because you won’t be able to rest for a while. Don’t let those creatures reach you if you don’t want to get bitten! Come prepared and be ready to fight!

name: School of Magic
description:
In School of Magic, you will learn how to cast different spells and become a true magician. Grab your wand sorcerers and face the darkness!

Launch Fireballs and move objects to solve puzzles in this cooperative escape room!

Every room is a test, every corridor can hide a secret and every spell is a key…

Will you become strong enough to challenge the dragon? Awaken the magic within you and unleash your true power!

name: Sherlock's Journey
description:
Sherlock Holmes has vanished, and your only lead points 200 years into the future. As Sherlock’s apprentices, guided by Dr. Watson, you start the mysterious time machine your mentor last used and land in the year 2181. The future belongs to Moriarty, now head of the powerful tech empire Infinity Corp, and he seems to have planned for everything, even your arrival.

Explore a cyberpunk city, investigate clues, solve puzzles, outwit traps and fight Moriarty’s forces. Your mission is to find Sherlock, stop Moriarty and get back to your own time before it’s too late.

Can you outsmart Moriarty?

name: Sintclair vs Dracula
description:
Travel back to 1881 to stop Dracula before he plunges the world into eternal night.

Play as an elite Sintclair squad and experience a full narrative campaign combining explosive combat, cooperative objectives, defensive battles, area purification missions, and intense encounters against hordes of vampires, zombies, and demonic creatures in a horror western blending futuristic weapons with a supernatural apocalypse.

name: Smurfs: Blueberry Battle
description:
Immerse yourself in a virtual playground and explore the enchanting world of the Smurfs. Stay vigilant, as mysterious mushrooms are on the verge of invading the Village and freezing the Smurfs! As always, the cunning Gargamel will seize every opportunity to cast evil spells on the Smurfs, turning them into ice cubes.

In this action-packed adventure, players will need to show skill, unite their forces, and repel the invaders with their blueberry launchers to save the Village, free the Smurfs, and score as many points as possible!

name: Space Academy
description:
Explore the farthest reaches of space with your crew in Space Academy.

Let yourself be carried away and open your eyes wide to this spectacle.

name: Star Force
description:
Sicaro-9: A distant planet rich with exocrystals, the key to humanity's survival. But this energy source is fiercely guarded by the relentless hive, a deadly alien force that will stop at nothing to protect it.

Your mission: extract the exocrystals and defend the mining operation against an onslaught of ruthless enemies. Only those with skill, strategy, and firepower will succeed.

Join forces with up to 7 other players and prove that Star Force is unstoppable!

name: SuperHero Escape Room
description:
In this parallel universe, you are the one with superpowers! Use them to save yourself, your friends and the entire human race. But remember… with great power comes great responsibility.

The world is in grave danger. Use your powers wisely and face the challenges that lie ahead!

Will you manage to save the world in this race against time? Will you be able to cooperate and overcome the obstacles?

You’ll find out when you step into the shoes of tomorrow’s superheroes.

name: Temple Quest
description:
Show off your adventurous side and let yourself be transported into the universe of TEMPLE QUEST! Travel in magnificent settings and challenge your friends by collecting the most diamonds in this VR freeroam adventure.

During your quest, you will encounter many trials. You will be faced with dilemmas in a permanent state of danger!

Feel the molten lava and the power of the wind! Admire the beautiful vistas but don’t let your fear of heights take you into the distant void! Will you come back richer and in one piece at the end of this breathtaking adventure?

During your quest, you will encounter many trials. Will you escape the temple’s maze? Are you fast enough to avoid the traps set out by this ancient civilization?

At the end of this breathtaking adventure, will you come back richer, your hands full of gems? Find out for yourself in TEMPLE QUEST!

Gather your party and have fun in a series of minigames for the whole family that will test your dexterity and skill.

Defend the lava temple with your friends and aim for the monoliths to get diamonds! Feel the effects of hyper VR in TEMPLE PARTY!

Feel the heat of molten lava, the wind, the shaking ground, and all of the VEX Adventure special effects. Gather the most diamonds to win the minigames!

name: Terminator Uprising
description:
A high-intensity VR shooter set in a war-torn future where humanity fights its last battle against the machines. Designed as a cinematic, adrenaline-filled blockbuster that attracts players of all ages.

The war for the future has begun! Step into the ruins of humanity's last stand and join the resistance against the machines. TERMINATOR UPRISING throws you straight into the action. Heart-pounding combat, intense co-op missions, and the ultimate fight for survival. 🦾 Suit up. Lock in. Defend humanity. The machines are rising.

name: The Break-In
description:
Crompton Bank. Middle of the night. A heavily armed gang hits hard and vanishes without a trace. What they left behind? A breached vault... and a trail of questions. You're part of an elite Special Forces unit: together, you'll investigate the scene, track digital evidence and unravel the gang's next move before they strike again.

Teamwork is your only weapon.

name: The Ghoulies
description:
Your gang has been dared to enter the creepy old house of Old Man Marley, a crazed killer whose victims are said to still haunt its halls.

Your mission sounds simple: get inside, work together, find everything on the list and get out before you're trapped there forever. Search possessed furniture, uncover hidden cubby holes and explore a house where nothing is quite what it seems.

Keep your nerve, stick together and whatever you do...

DON'T OPEN THAT TRAP DOOR!

name: The Hallow
description:
Your journey takes you back to the 1800s, where a powerful mage entrusts you with a mysterious assignment. Responding to reports of strange and demonic activity in the local area, your team must face relentless hordes of terrifying zombies and ruthless, demonic creatures.

Only by working together can you survive the chaos.

name: The Parvus Box
description:
We need you for a small experiment...

You have volunteered to test an experimental device capable of shrinking you down to microscopic size. When the experiment goes wrong, you'll have to work together and solve collaborative puzzles to return to normal size.

name: Trials of Atlantis
description:
Want to ride on the back of a whale? Unload ships at the Atlantean harbor, break into the treasury vault, or fight an octopus?

Trials of Atlantis offers five unique trials, and each one will challenge your team in unique ways. Are you clever enough to solve the puzzles? Are you fast enough to beat the time? And brave enough to face the horrors of the deep? Master the trials to restore Atlantis to its full glory!

name: Versus
description:
Versus is a retro futuristic free roam VR laser tag game where players battle in intense PvP matches using the V-99 Blaster. Compete in Team Battle or Free-For-All modes.

Fire energy blasts with one hand while using a shield in the other to block incoming attacks.. Fast paced, competitive, and easy to replay, Versus delivers thrilling VR battles for all skill levels.

name: VR Birthday Party
description: A vibrant and unforgettable kids' party in virtual reality! Thrilling team battles in a balloon fortress, fun-filled amusement park adventures and a sweet kingdom with a giant birthday cake for the guest of honor.

name: VR Party Games
description: A collection of casual games designed specifically for children from 6 years old. Five mini-games with unique and simple mechanics, carefully crafted maps and exciting, varied gameplay.

name: Wayfinders
description:
Brace yourself for an adrenaline-pumping space journey!

Escape From Aurora seamlessly blends interactive sequences with cinematic action, keeping you on the edge from start to finish. Travel to the heart of Aurora station which is on the brink of destruction. Your mission? Navigate your way through the ravaged rooms of the station and save its crew before all is lost!

name: Wizard Academy
description:
Welcome to Wizard Academy, where you and your friends step into the robes of wizard students, racing against time to complete your final magical exam!

In this fun cooperative puzzle game, each of you must work through a series of mystical tasks, casting spells, collecting artifacts, and uncovering secrets to prove your prowess before time runs out.

name: Zombie Urban Factory
description:
Survive waves of the undead while he taunts you, studies you… and enjoys himself. No puzzles. Just pure survival.

Use different weapons and try to survive as many waves as possible! Fight with your friends and cooperate to stay alive.

Kidnapped. Used as guinea pigs. Besieged by zombies.

A mad scientist has locked you up in an abandoned factory to test his monsters.

Abducted. Taken to the Moon. Used as guinea pigs.

A mad scientist has locked you up in his Alpha-13 lunar colony and unleashed his zombies just to see how long you’ll survive.
